import fcntl,json,os,subprocess,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from curation.attach_reviews import attach
from curation.schema import digest,load_manifest
from curation.review import atomic
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
held=(root/'finalizer.lock').open('a');fcntl.flock(held,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
state={'pid':os.getpid(),'status':'waiting_for_review_worker','started_at':time.time()}
atomic(root/'finalizer.json',state)
try:
 while True:
  worker=json.loads((root/'worker.json').read_text())
  if worker['status']!='running':break
  proc=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(worker['pid']),'-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if proc.returncode or str(root.name) not in proc.stdout:raise RuntimeError('worker missing; inspect without replay')
  time.sleep(30)
 if worker['status']!='complete':raise RuntimeError('review worker did not complete; inspect failures')
 assert digest(root/'input.jsonl')==worker['input_sha256']
 summary=json.loads((root/'reviews/summary.json').read_text())
 assert not summary['stopped_early'] and len(summary['completed'])+len(summary['failed'])==worker['rows']
 state['status']='validating_and_attaching';atomic(root/'finalizer.json',state)
 original=load_manifest(root/'input.jsonl');rows,counts=attach(original,root/'reviews')
 assert counts['attached']==len(summary['completed'])
 assert all(a['sentence']==b['sentence'] and a['audio_sha256']==b['audio_sha256'] for a,b in zip(original,rows))
 target=root/'reviewed-manifest.jsonl'
 with target.open('x') as f:
  for row in rows:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
 audit={'rows':len(rows),**counts,'rejected':len(summary['failed']),'manifest_sha256':digest(target),'input_sha256':worker['input_sha256'],'transcript_changes':0,'audio_approvals':0,'model_requests_by_finalizer':0}
 atomic(root/'join-audit.json',audit)
 state.update(status='complete',finished_at=time.time(),audit=audit)
except Exception as exc:
 state.update(status='stopped_for_inspection',error_type=type(exc).__name__,reason=str(exc),finished_at=time.time());traceback.print_exc()
finally:atomic(root/'finalizer.json',state)
